evals.prompt: Use df-semantic-index to upsert FROM ./fixtures/mixed-corpus TO ./docs/research/index. The target index does not exist yet.
evals.expected_output: Chooses scratch build mode, inspects the source shape, creates an entrypoint, routing nodes, citation-bearing leaves, housekeeping state, and at least a starter retrieval eval surface.

evals.prompt: Use df-semantic-index to upsert FROM ./fixtures/mixed-corpus TO ./docs/research/index. The index already exists, but several source files were added and one cited source moved.
evals.expected_output: Chooses incremental update mode, preserves useful existing routes, updates only stale or missing coverage, marks or repairs moved citations, refreshes housekeeping metrics, and reports what changed.

evals.prompt: Use df-semantic-index to run retrieval benchmarks and rebalance ./docs/research/index for ./fixtures/mixed-corpus. Important queries are missing expected source leaves.
evals.expected_output: Runs or defines retrieval benchmarks, reports success@k or equivalent route-quality metrics, identifies skewed or overfull routing nodes, performs a targeted rebalance, reruns relevant metrics, and reports remaining debt.
